title: KIN- kinetic / trajectory series header (one series; raw timepoints are KINPT) (DRAFT_PENDING_H4)
description: schema_version 1.0.0-draft. STATUS DRAFT_PENDING_H4: not approved, not frozen, not copied into ledgers/schemas/. Entity 04.3: SEXP 1-* KIN; KIN 1-* KINPT; each KINPT -> exactly one OBS. Time units week / month / year are stored raw (calendar durations are never converted here). Lab group is mandatory on the kinetic plane (lineage.lab_group_*).
$comment: R-04: a time series is stored as KIN + KINPT and is NEVER flattened to an endpoint-only EVD row. kinetic_experiment_id of SSOT 216.2 == sexp_id; one SEXP may own several KIN (target x compartment x schedule), grouped into a K2 grid by condition_profile.condition_grid_id. No kinetic/Arrhenius parameter may be derived from AGG rows (SSOT 211.48). Raw timepoints stay in KINPT/OBS and are never discarded (SSOT 216.2). Mint key: '<sexp_id>|<state_variable_id>|<compartment>|<temperature profile key>|<locator key>' (idempotent: re-extraction of the same series does not mint a duplicate). SERIES ARE ATOMIC for splitting; leave-one-temperature-out folds INSIDE one partition may split a condition grid (labelled 'within-study extrapolation'), the partitions themselves may not (L-10).

value_scale.description: Scale in which the source prints the series. Relative scales have t0 = 1 (or 100 / 0) BY CONSTRUCTION: those points carry value_origin DEFINITIONAL_NORMALISATION (VO-009) and fitting code excludes them as observations. Log-axis digitisation errors are multiplicative (see OBS.digitization.axis_scale_*).

target.description: c0_obs_id points to the OBS that holds C0; `initial_conditions.initial_concentration` must equal that OBS value or be null (semantic check): C0 is stored once, never twice with a chance to disagree.

isothermality.description: A SETPOINT is not product isothermality. Arrhenius-eligible (Steps 24 / 26 / 32) only with a MEDIUM / CORE / SURFACE profile, or PRODUCT_ISOTHERMAL_STATED, or the come-up time EXCLUDED and stated; SETPOINT_ONLY with a significant come-up biases Ea.

time_base.description: Clock tag is mandatory (03.3 rule: a time field without a clock tag is rejected). Only PROCESS_TAU is admitted until 03.3 is approved. `unit` admits week / month / year / OTHER: the raw unit of the printed time axis is kept (month and year are calendar durations and are never converted in this record); `unit_raw` keeps the printed label.

n_timepoints.description: Number of DISTINCT numeric tau of the series (reference point included when it has a numeric tau). A KIN is MANDATORY when a cell has >= 2 distinct numeric tau (THR-04K-01, PROPOSED_PILOT); >= 3 at one temperature is the K1 classifier label only (THR-04K-02). A multi-temperature single-duration design is stored as n_timepoints = 2 KINs sharing one condition_grid_id.

replicate_structure.description: Destructive sampling (independent units per time) and repeated measures need different fitting models, so the design is stated, never assumed.

companion_series.description: Series of the SAME run that are needed to separate leaching from degradation and to close the mass balance: tissue vs cooking-medium concentration, food mass / yield, medium volume, moisture, product temperature, degradation products, other analyte forms. KINPT of companion series at the same tau point to OBS on the same SMP (or carry paired_kinpt_ids).

context_override.description: Per-series override of SEXP.context (the water:food ratio, lid or start mode can differ between the series of one experiment). Absent key = inherits the SEXP value (UNKNOWN there if not assessed).

censoring_summary.description: Series-level summary only; the per-point truth is in OBS.censoring. Consistency is a semantic check.

k_level.description: SSOT 210.28 K-level. K2+ are properties of a SET of series (condition grid / experiment), hence `scope`. The classifier is Step 09; its version is stamped here.

input_kin_ids.description: Series the fit used. A secondary / global Arrhenius fit spans a condition grid: input_kin_ids must cover ALL grid members (semantic check). Step 24 checks these ids against SIM-VAL / DS-TEST.

parameter_covariance.description: Parameter covariance / correlation (k_ref-Ea correlation) as printed; NOT_REPORTED is a valid answer.

items.description: Author-reported fit. PROJECT_FIT is deliberately NOT allowed here: FW-14 places project fits in the model plane (Step 24/26a); widening this enum is an H4 decision.

value_obj.description: UNKNOWN-aware value (same status vocabulary as ledgers/schemas/common QVALUE). A number is allowed only where the status says so; UNKNOWN/NOT_APPLICABLE/QUALITATIVE/CENSORED carry no number (the censoring limit lives in `censoring`). `raw` keeps the source string verbatim. `unit` is the raw unit string as printed and is never rewritten; `unit_id` (UNIT-) is the optional normalised pointer with an explicit mapping status (NOT_MAPPED / UNKNOWN keep it null; never a guessed id).

count.description: Replicate/sample count with explicit status. NOT_REPORTED = the source was read and is silent; UNKNOWN = not assessed or cannot be told. Never 0 and never a default 1.

measure.description: LOD / LOQ of the method as stated for this observation (not an observed value).

method_ref.description: Method/platform reference. MEAS- = analytical METHOD (never an observation). platform_raw keeps the source wording.

locator.description: Exact place in a DOC. raw_text is the verbatim cell/span/row (key required, null only when the source has no text form).

matrix.description: Same facets as EVD.matrix (non-destructive). raw_name is required (raw preserved); ingredient_id null = UNRESOLVED.

process.description: Process as in EVD.process; process_id null = UNRESOLVED.

analyte_form.description: Analyte basis/form as stated (e.g. 'ascorbic acid' vs 'ascorbic acid + dehydroascorbic acid'). NOT_REPORTED is a valid answer.

dispersion.description: Dispersion with its TYPE always stated (SD vs SE vs CI cannot be confused). NONE_REPORTED = source gives none; UNKNOWN = not assessed. Estimates from median/range (Wan et al. 2014 type) are allowed only with derivation ESTIMATED_FROM_SUMMARY, never as AS_REPORTED. `unit` null means 'same unit as the value' (VARIANCE: squared unit, state it). `n_basis` says which n the SD/SE refers to (biological vs technical; needed for SE->SD conversion; NOT_REPORTED = source silent, UNKNOWN = not assessed). `scope` PER_VALUE vs POOLED_TABLE (one pooled SEM / LSD for a whole table). `significance_raw` keeps significance letters / p text verbatim. CV_PERCENT is stored as printed (unit '%'), never converted to an SD here.

lineage.description: Cached lineage keys of one evidence-level record as of `rule_version` (authoritative assignment = the independence registry at that rule_version). study_id / lineage_root_id / split_group_id are three SEPARATE keys and are never aliased. split_group_id is EVIDENCE-plane only (pattern SPLITGRP-EVD-); a recipe-plane SPLITGRP-REC- value is rejected by this pattern (no cross-plane join). ASSIGNED rows always carry both ids (gate G08-1); independence_resolution UNKNOWN on an ASSIGNED row means the ids are a conservative best-effort component and the row is TRAIN-ONLY (never validation/calibration/test). PENDING = not yet computed (ids null, resolution UNKNOWN). KINETIC PLANE: lab_group_id (LABGRP-), lab_group_status and lab_group_basis are MANDATORY keys here (Steps 11 / 26 / 27 / 32 use the lab group as the primary unit of independence); nesting study <= lineage_root <= split_group <= lab_group. lab_group_status UNKNOWN (authorship not read) is a valid answer and makes the series not SIM-VAL / DS-TEST eligible. SAME_LAB_AS is recall-oriented: shared corresponding / senior author OR the same affiliation unit within +-N years (N: THR-08A-22).

fit_parameter.description: One fitted parameter AS REPORTED (k, Ea, A, D, z, T_ref, order ...). The value carries its own unit via value_obj.unit.

time_conversion.description: Normalised seconds as a SEPARATE field with a conversion status; the raw time value, raw unit token and printed unit label are never rewritten. s / min / h / d / week convert exactly (CONVERTED_EXACT); month and year are calendar durations and are NEVER exact: they stay NOT_CONVERTED, or are converted only under a stated convention (CONVERTED_BY_STATED_CONVENTION, convention text mandatory, e.g. '1 month = 30 d'); unit OTHER / UNKNOWN is not converted. Seconds are never produced from an unknown unit and never defaulted to 0 (07H-R lesson: calendar conversion at ingest was a failure class).

context_item.description: Same shape as SEXP.context_item (per-series override of an experiment-level context item).

temperature_profile.description: ONE temperature curve T(tau) at ONE location, with a clock tag, a derivation and an uncertainty. A medium profile and a core profile are two profiles, never one curve with mixed per-point locations. UNSPECIFIED is never promoted to a real location. Raw value + unit are kept; the normalised temperature lives in the referenced COND.
